source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let L : Fin N → ℝ := fun j => Real.log (p j : ℝ)
  let d : Fin N → ℝ := fun j =>
    (xiTransversePrimeApertureDiskNode 1 (p j) /
      (1 + xiTransversePrimeApertureDiskNode 1 (p j))) * L j
  have hL : Function.Injective L := by
    intro i j hij
    have hi : (0 : ℝ) < (p i : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (p i).2.pos
    have hj : (0 : ℝ) < (p j : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (p j).2.pos
    have hreal : (p i : ℝ) = (p j : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_log hi, ← Real.exp_log hj]
      exact congrArg Real.exp hij
    apply hp
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact_mod_cast hreal
  have hd : ∀ j, d j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    have hq : 0 < xiTransversePrimeApertureDiskNode 1 (p j) :=
      xiTransversePrimeApertureDiskNode_pos 1 (p j)
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < (p j : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (p j).2.one_lt
    dsimp only [d, L]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (div_ne_zero hq.ne' (by positivity))
      (Real.log_pos hp1).ne'
  rw [gammaSewnMobiusReesPrincipalSymbolMatrix_factorization,
    Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · exact Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr hL
  · rw [Matrix.det_diagonal, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
    exact fun j _ => hd j

theorem bdGram_half_quarter :
    bdGram (1 / (2 : ℝ)) (1 / (4 : ℝ)) = 5 * Real.log 2 / 16 - Real.pi / 32
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hT1 := hasSum_indicator_quarter (j := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _
    (hasSum_quarter_recip_real 1 _ hasSum_quarter_recip_one)
  have hT3 := hasSum_indicator_quarter (j := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _
    (hasSum_quarter_recip_real 3 _ hasSum_quarter_recip_three)
  have hcomb := ((hT1.add (hT3.mul_left 3))).mul_left (1 / 8 : ℝ)
  have hgram := hasSum_bdGram_discrete (m₁ := 2) (m₂ := 4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (1 / 8 : ℝ) * ((if (n + 1) % 4 = 1 then 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2)) else 0)
        + 3 * (if (n + 1) % 4 = 3 then 1 / (((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2)) else 0))
      = (((n + 1) % 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (((n + 1) % 4 : ℕ) : ℝ)
          / (((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((4 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ((n : ℝ) + 2)) := by
    intro n
    have h1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have h2 : ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≠ 0 := by positivity
